name: Gakushuin Centennial Hall
accessSummary: Mejiro Station (JR Yamanote Line): about 30 sec walk / Zoshigaya Station (Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line): about 7 min walk
notice: Applications may be declined at the Gakushuin's discretion, for example if the use is judged to be for profit, contrary to public order and morals, likely to damage the facilities or equipment, judged to be strongly religious or ideological and unsuitable for an educational setting, or likely to inconvenience neighbors or other users (Source: https://www.gakushuin.ac.jp/houjin/kikaku/map/index.html)
